binary: aikoql-mcp 0.4.0, release build from commit 1e51db4 (built locally; the npm registry still carries 0.2.4 at time of writing)

corpus.path: the aikoql repository itself (dogfood), staged copy with .git, target, .venv, node_modules, .superpowers, kb.ckpt, kb.artifacts excluded

method.retrieval: MCP tool recall (AG-02 hybrid retrieval, k=10, max_tokens=2000, subject ingest-dir) over the corpus ingested with `aikoql-mcp ingest-dir`
method.queries: benchmarks/scripts/fixtures/queries.json (3 task questions about aikoql internals)
method.baseline: corpus_tokens x 3 — without memory the agent re-reads the corpus on every turn; with it, one recall slice per turn
method.memory: sum of cl100k tokens of the recall content.text returned per query (what enters the agent's context)
method.harness: python benchmarks/scripts/token_savings.py --corpus <corpus> --queries benchmarks/scripts/fixtures/queries.json (AIKOQL_BIN and AIKOQL_DB point at the built binary and the ingested db)
method.variance: recall is freshness-dependent; two consecutive runs measured 6583 and 6538 memory tokens (0.7%)
